beta.notes:
# MisterZine Plex Core 0.1.0-beta.27.1

A stepping stone from beta.27: the 0.1.0-beta.28 app, worker, FFmpeg and
H.264 decoder core, packaged so that the updater installed with beta.27 can
install them. After it starts, Updates offers 0.1.0-beta.28 itself.

- Everything beta.28 brings is already in it; see the beta.28 notes for the
  new playback path, scrub previews, the playback looks and the supporter
  extras.
- Settings, sign-in and codes are kept. Rollback keeps the previous release.
- The output is chosen in the core's on-screen menu from now on.

# MisterZine Plex Core 0.1.0-beta.35

- A resume, a seek or Skip intro that the server never answers now fails
  after 20 seconds instead of a minute, and says what happened: the server
  accepted the request but sent no video. The playback log carries the same
  line for Send a report. Playing from the start is unaffected. (Seen with a
  server whose hardware-accelerated conversion stalls on a seek into 10-bit
  HEVC; turning off the server's hardware acceleration avoids it.)

Uses the same qualified FPGA core as beta.33, with an updated playback worker. Existing
settings, calibration and saved access are preserved. Rollback restores the
previous release.

memos.title: Welcome to beta 28 and up
memos.text: Beta 28 and up move the core to Ben Owen's new H.264 decoder. If the in-app update showed this as beta 27.1, the update automatically bumped you to beta 28 or newer. Thanks for testing! -Matija
